_about: A canned extract() result for the ARMRA fixture meeting — what the model proposes BEFORE any code has judged it. Shared by engine/test-offline.js and demo.js so the tests and the demo cannot drift. Every item carries _trap describing what it is there to exercise; reconcile.js ignores unknown fields, so it flows through untouched.

summary.headline: ARMRA batch 3: buyer redefined, athlete angle cut then partly restored, offer changed
summary.narrative: Dana rejected the athlete recovery angle and described the real buyer as an exhausted woman in her forties who has tried other supplements without result. She set tone (warm, plain spoken, never clinical) and a hard legal boundary against treat/cure claims, and confirmed every ad must carry the FDA disclaimer. The active offer changed on Monday from 20% off to buy two get one free, which kills existing creative. Late in the call she partly reversed the athlete decision, keeping one concept as a test. Retainer pricing was explicitly deferred to a contract conversation.
